title: Parliament LIVE: Nirmala Sitharaman Presents Economic Survey | Budget Session 2026 | Lok Sabha
text: Parliament LIVE: Nirmala Sitharaman Presents Economic Survey | Budget Session 2026 | Lok SabhaUnion Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman presents the Economic Survey in Parliament. The survey, which is prepared by the Finance Ministry’s Economic Division, reviews India’s economic performance and key indicators for 2025–26. It outlines the outlook for the next financial year.
